description: Crown Castle International Corp. owns, operates and leases shared communications infrastructure that is geographically dispersed throughout the U.S., including more than 40,000 towers and other structures such as rooftops, approximately 105,000 small cell nodes either currently generating revenue or under contract, and approximately 90,000 route miles of fiber primarily supporting small cells and fiber solutions, which it refers to collectively as communications infrastructure. Its operating segments historically consisted of Towers and Fiber, and on March 13, 2025 management signed a definitive agreement to sell its Fiber segment, with Zayo Group Holdings Inc. acquiring the fiber solutions business and an EQT Active Core Infrastructure fund acquiring the small cells business. Its strategy to create long-term stockholder value is based on its belief that there will be considerable future demand for its towers based on the location of its assets and the rapid and continuing growth in the demand for data.
